description: Registration must restate the signed manifest exactly: plugin_id, interface, capabilities[] (within the manifest envelope), operations[] each matching a manifest descriptor byte-for-byte; top-level description is ignored by the daemon
source: BBB_V2_AUDIT.md section 6.2; plugin_host.c:2900-3105; rpc.c:2384-2428; bbb.go:129-143, 278-290; bbb_test.go:142-225
checked_by: framing round-trip now; admission semantics land with the Go host plugin manager

vectors.name: request_full
vectors.note: shape from the Go SDK's own registration test; every operation field must equal the signed manifest descriptor, capability_tags in count AND order (plugin_host.c:2933-2946)

vectors.name: request_capability_free_sends_empty_array
vectors.note: capabilities is wire-required; a missing or non-array field is PARAMS_INVALID (plugin_host.c:2900-2906); the Go SDK normalizes nil to [] (bbb.go:285-287)

vectors.name: invalid_operations_missing
vectors.note: operations must be a non-empty array (EMPTY_OPERATION_SET / PARAMS_INVALID reasons travel as the error message, rpc.c:2396-2399; exact reason strings live in plugin_host_internal.h and are not restated here unverified)

vectors.name: invalid_plugin_id_missing
vectors.cite: plugin_host.c:3077-3082 (plugin_id and interface must be strings)
